trigger: I am being denied a lawyer or a phone call
description: What to do if the police will not let you contact a lawyer or your family.

steps.text: Stay calm and keep asking respectfully; do not give up your right.
Say clearly: 'I have a right to a lawyer of my choice (s.36(6)(c)), and I wish to remain silent until I speak to one (s.35(2)).'
Ask for the name and number of the officer refusing you, and note the time.
Do not answer questions or sign any statement while you are being denied a lawyer.
Ask them to inform your family or a named person that you are being held.
If you get any chance to call, contact your lawyer or a trusted person immediately.
Being denied a lawyer is a rights violation you or your lawyer can raise in court (s.46).
